subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text.
stimulus: The boy said to the teacher, “Sir, please pray for me”. “Yes, of course. But why?” said the teacher. “I am going to sit for the SSC Exam this year”. “How is your preparation?” “Very good, sir. I hope, I will get GPA-5,” said the boy. “How confident you are! May Allah fulfill your expectation.” “Thank you sir,” said the boy.
guide_solution: Changing the form of speech The boy requested the teacher respectfully to pray for him (B). The teacher replied in the affirmative and said that he would surely pray for him (B). The teacher also asked why he would pray for him. The boy replied that he was going to sit for the SSC Exam that year. The teacher asked how his (B) preparation was. The boy replied respectfully that his preparation was very good. He (B) also added that he hoped he would get GPA-5. The teacher exclaimed with wonder that he was very confident. He (T) also prayed that Allah might fulfill his expectation. The boy thanked him (Teacher) respectfully.
